feedback: Month end takes too long because I have to compare the payment report with our bank records.
Most of my time goes into checking which transactions do not match.
I would rather review exceptions than every successful payment.
Refunds make reconciliation much harder to follow.
Reconciliation is still one of the slowest parts of month end.
I sent a payment reminder twice because I could not see that one had already gone.
When customers query a payment I need a clearer history of what was sent and when.
A simple communication history would stop us repeating payment messages.
